labels: []

<!-- Pick one area label: area: site, area: content, area: docs, area: deps, area: ci -->

## Problem

What is wrong, missing, or being built — and why it matters. A reader who
never sees the diff should still understand the point.

## Scope

What this piece of work covers. One context per issue: if two reviewers
would need different context, open two issues.

## Deliberately left out

The adjacent work this issue does NOT do, so scope creep has a name.

## Done when

The observable outcome that closes this issue.
